name: Red knot
desc: Probes for buried shellfish and swallows them whole. It breeds on Arctic tundra and stops over on coastal mudflats such as the Wadden Sea.
about: The red knot or just knot is a medium-sized shorebird which breeds in tundra and the Arctic Cordillera in the far north of Canada, Europe, and Russia. It is the type species of the genus Calidris.
